# 5 bed detached house for sale

> Heather Cottage is a striking contemporary home on Dublin's windswept Howth Peninsula, one of the most coveted coastal locations in Ireland. This one-of-a-kind, five-bedroom home sits discreetly into the landscape in an area of outstanding natural beauty, just outside Howth village. Heather Cottage is the last word in discretion.

## Fakta
- Typ: detached house
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 5 bed
- Plocha: 340 m²
- Energetická náročnost: B2
- Lokalita: Heather Cottage, Upper Cliff Road, Howth
- Cena: 4 950 000 €
